title: Conversation with Elon Musk and Jensen Huang on AI, Robotics, and AI Factories

participants.name: Elon Musk
participants.role: Founder of SpaceX and xAI; CEO of Tesla

topics: Future of work with AI and automation
Energy and compute scaling in space
summary_brief: The discussion features Elon Musk and Jensen Huang exploring the future of AI, robotics, energy systems, and large-scale compute. They highlight the transition from retrieval-based computing to generative AI, the rise of humanoid robots, and the global need for AI factories. Broader topics include productivity, workforce changes, space-based compute, major US–Saudi AI partnerships, and emerging scientific and industrial applications enabled by advanced AI systems.

actions.task: Advance development of the 500MW xAI–Saudi AI compute facility
actions.description_plain: Continue coordinating with partners in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and Nvidia to build and deploy the planned 500-megawatt AI compute infrastructure, starting with the 50MW first phase.

actions.task: Expand Omniverse and digital twin collaborations with Humane
actions.description_plain: Deepen work with Humane to apply Nvidia’s Omniverse platform to robotics, digital factories, and quantum simulation initiatives in Saudi Arabia.
